metadata.scope: ANSI #25, #35, #40, #50 roller chain sprockets with hub, bore, and keyway.

material_suggestions.notes: Through-harden tooth faces to HRC 45–50 for wear life.

material_suggestions.use_case: lightweight sprockets for robots and light conveyors
material_suggestions.notes: Adequate for low-torque; anodise tooth flanks.
Add 0.3–0.5 mm tooth clearance for chain engagement.

standards_used.name: ANSI B29.1
standards_used.applies_to: roller chain pitch, roller diameter, and inner width
standards_used.note: #40: pitch 12.7 mm, roller ø7.92 mm, inner width 7.85 mm.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: ANSI #40 chain 17-tooth sprocket
main_features: tooth spaces as subtractive roller pockets at pitch circle
root relief cylinder removing material below pitch
design_rules: pitch_d from formula not from bore
roller pockets on pitch circle not random
root_d cylinder subtracted to create tooth height
hub extends above and below tooth plate
failure_modes: roller pockets not at pitch radius

constraint_checks.message: Sprocket pitch diameter must use the correct formula.
Sprocket must have roller pocket cutouts at pitch circle.
